dialogues.speaker: Rika
dialogues.text: Ugh... overall results are barely acceptable, I guess. But when I total up the gains and expenses this time, things don't look great...

choices.text: I want to go over the train simulation again.

response.speaker: Rika
response.text: Go over it? Sure, sure! We can start right away.

choices.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

response.speaker: Rika
response.text: Take care on your way back. I still need to settle the accounts...

response.speaker: Rika
response.text: Oh no... why does it look like I'm going to end up 150,000 in the red again...?
